judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner, as a travel operator, sought to challenge the Respondents\' decision to not call it for interviews for the 2026 Hajj/Umrah Pilgrimage; compliance with the Guidelines to Regulate Hajj/Umrah Pilgrimages from Sri Lanka as approved by the learned Supreme Court; Article 12 and 13 violations. Held – Respondents\' decision is justified as the Petitioner has several pending cases based on serious allegations; relief sought is now academic. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
